snippet.title: DRIVE IN THE RAIN | DEVELOPMENT TRAILER [ENG]
snippet.description:
DRIVE IN THE RAIN is a horror-tinged, experiential road-movie adventure in which the story unfolds through your passengers' conversations as you drive a rain-lashed highway to your destination. Players simply keep driving down a rainy highway at night, straight toward their destination.

Currently in development!

Coming soon to Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4703000/

Developer: YAYOI KAIHATSU - https://x.com/distillate_yama
Illustrator: DAHLIA - https://x.com/syougayaki0000
Trailer Voice Artist: kasuka.com - https://x.com/kasuka_com_
